findings.problem: The design requires a seeded:// source URL while declaring source_url as Pydantic HttpUrl; installed Pydantic rejects non-http(s) schemes.
findings.location: Shared contracts, provenance, registries, and cache identity
findings.fix: Use a validated string/custom URL type that permits the exact seeded URI, or use an https canonical demo URL; define accepted schemes in backend and frontend contracts.

findings.problem: New reviews columns and review_events are proposed without a migration path for the existing SQLite schema.
findings.location: Chosen architecture and durable review execution
findings.fix: Add an idempotent, transactionally tested SQLite schema migration with version tracking, missing-column additions, review_events/index creation, and status backfill.

findings.problem: SSE nested payloads remain dict[str, object] rather than defined Pydantic/TypeScript discriminated contracts.
findings.location: Cached review, API, audit, and errors
findings.fix: Define extra-forbidden event variants and typed status/tool/verdict/done/error payload models, including a required done.review_id, then mirror them in TypeScript.

findings.problem: Lease ownership/reclamation has no owner token or lease duration in store method signatures, allowing stale executors to complete.
findings.location: Chosen architecture and durable review execution
findings.fix: Persist an execution owner token and expiry; require them atomically in renew, event append, complete, and fail operations, with stale-worker tests.

findings.problem: The city/district registry design uses city_id but the current Project/index contracts contain only city/district, with no canonical mapping.
findings.location: Shared contracts, provenance, registries, and cache identity
findings.fix: Add explicit canonical city_id/district_id fields to normalized projects and index metadata, validate district-to-city membership from GeoJSON, and use IDs only for filtering/taxonomy.

findings.problem: Retrieval does not specify how implementation_start/end maps to current project approval_date/closing_date or where the 12-month slack is applied.
findings.location: Retrieval, providers, taxonomy, and live agent
findings.fix: Define the field mapping, inclusive predicate, missing-date rule, and whether slack is taxonomy-only; rename metadata or document legacy mapping and test boundaries.

findings.problem: The design implies atomic existing index reconciliation although only manifest replacement is atomic in the current builder.
findings.location: Retrieval, providers, taxonomy, and live agent
findings.fix: Describe this as planned work and specify staging/swap or deterministic repair behavior for partial Chroma mutation failure.
